description: Christmas sugar cookies 💫 Recipe: Christmas Sprinkle Sugar Cookies Prep: 15 minutes Cook: 10 minutes Servings: 10 cookies Ingredients 	•	113 g unsalted butter (room temperature) 	•	150 g granulated sugar 	•	½ large egg (room temperature) 	•	½ large egg yolk (room temperature) 	•	½ Tbsp semi-skimmed milk 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract 	•	⅛ tsp almond extract (optional, for classic sugar cookie flavor) 	•	172½ g all-purpose flour (spooned & leveled) 	•	¾ tsp baking powder 	•	⅜ tsp salt 	•	¼ tsp baking soda 	•	40 g red and green jimmies sprinkles (plus more for topping) 	•	25 g granulated sugar (for rolling and garnishing) ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Preheat Oven & Prepare Baking Sheets: Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. 	2.	Cream Butter and Sugar: In a large mixing bowl, use a hand mixer or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment to cream the butter and granulated sugar on medium speed for 2–3 minutes, until light and fluffy. 	3.	Add Wet Ingredients: Beat in the egg, egg yolk, semi-skimmed milk, vanilla extract, and almond extract (if using) until smooth and fully combined. Scrape down the sides as needed. 	4.	Add Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda. Gradually mix into the wet ingredients on low speed until a soft dough forms. 	5.	Fold in Sprinkles: Gently fold in the red and green jimmies until evenly distributed throughout the dough. 	6.	Scoop & Roll: Scoop about 2 tablespoons of dough per cookie and roll into balls. Roll each ball in granulated sugar before placing on the prepared baking sheets, spacing cookies about 2 inches apart. Optional: Chill the dough for 1 hour or up to 3 days. Bring to room temperature before rolling and baking. 	7.	Bake: Bake for 8–10 minutes, until the edges are set and just barely golden. The centers should still look slightly soft. Avoid overbaking. 	8.	Cool: Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 3–5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
